annotations.title: Send a file to Telegram home

description: Send one local file (video, photo, audio, pdf) to the user's Telegram home chat — the same Hermes bot channel they already configured. Use it when a render or export finished on disk and the user is not at the machine: pass the absolute path, optionally a short caption. The recipient is NEVER chosen by you: only TELEGRAM_HOME_CHANNEL from the assistant .env. Caps: 48 MB, allow-listed types (mp4/mov/webm/mkv, jpg/png/webp/gif, wav/mp3/ogg, pdf). Needs the Mnemosyne OS app RUNNING: on macOS its window may be closed (the app stays up and the host reads the file); on Windows and Linux closing the last window quits the app, so it must be open. Refusals: NO_TELEGRAM (bot or home chat missing), TOO_LARGE, BAD_TYPE, NOT_A_FILE, BAD_REQUEST.

caption.description: Optional caption shown under the media (max 1024 characters).

path.description: Absolute path of the file on this machine (e.g. a finished MP4). Relative paths are refused.

name: mnemosyne_telegram_send
